prerequisite: First finish exact categorical/layout integration and the authorized full-pipeline profile. Pursue this candidate only if the dense upward-update linear transformation remains a material measured runtime component; a broad trunk phase or hidden-state spectrum alone is insufficient justification.
candidate: Rank-r factorization of the upward-update affine map only; retain complete32D states and every existing biological information route.
candidate_equation: h_v=LayerNorm(b_v+tanh(U_r*(V_r*[b_v;aggregate_v])+c)), U_r in R^(32xr), V_r in R^(rx64), no intermediate bias or activation.
scope: Apply the same factorized shared update in both existing full-depth sweeps. Leave upward/downward message maps, branch geometry/support gates, all observed SNP encoding and early sampled-node injection, structural/episode residuals, stable-sample history, genomic GRUs, focal coordinates and classifier unchanged.

complexity.other_costs: All message maps, gates, LayerNorm, transfers, pooling, history, decoder and preparation costs remain. Two smaller GEMMs may lose kernel efficiency; only measured end-to-end time can establish benefit.

initialization_and_contract: This is a separately versioned changed model/checkpoint/optimizer contract. A truncated-SVD initialization from the same frozen checkpoint can control the starting approximation, but does not preserve the original function or optimizer moments. Register that conversion and matched baseline before outcomes. Never alter the exact49-tensor runtime or its resume lineage.
local_error_fact: For fixed incoming z and exact gates, ||(W-U_r*V_r)z||_2 <= ||W-U_r*V_r||_2*||z||_2 before tanh. Tanh is1-Lipschitz, but LayerNorm sensitivity, repeated nonlinear tree propagation and training prevent inferring a complete-model error/accuracy bound.
biological_tradeoff: All input observations, active edge supports, full-depth reference-to-query paths and32D residual states remain. The rank restriction may suppress distinctions in how SNP/base and aggregate context jointly update a lineage, including rare source/short-tract evidence. It is a narrower, easier-to-falsify change than moving all genotype evidence to a late head or projecting interval support into a global basis.
prior_art_distinction: Reduced-rank linear maps, truncated-SVD approximation and low-rank neural-network compression are established. This proposal is a model compression ablation motivated by a prospective measured bottleneck, not a new graph operator, biological ancestry mechanism, novelty or accuracy claim.
evaluation: Freeze rank/initialization using TRAIN and a registered validation rule. Compare unchanged exact TreeLoom continuation and the separate rank-constrained model on identical complete frozen parents, observations, targets and optimizer-update/data budgets, then separately equal wall-time. Preserve split discipline and existing output support. Report accuracy, per-class recall, NLL/calibration, qualified dense boundaries/short-tract recall, cold and warm total time, host/GPU peaks and parameter counts. Reject if smaller-GEMM overhead removes the saving or quality breaches predeclared margins; sparse American focals alone cannot substantiate dense boundary quality.
fallback: If profiling points instead to preparation, transfers, pooling, serial GRU or launch/synchronization overhead, do not select this factorization; address the measured component directly.
